about: Flagged (not permissive) third-party items the desktop bundle may ship. scripts/third_party_licenses.py --check fails on any flagged entry not covered here: same source, name glob, and a class no worse than the one listed. Add a row only once the licence is fine for a GPL-3.0-only build.

allow.name: ffmpeg
allow.why: GPL build, compatible with GPL-3.0-only; source links ship in licenses/

allow.name: ffprobe
allow.why: GPL build, compatible with GPL-3.0-only; source links ship in licenses/

allow.name: fpcalc
allow.why: Chromaprint, takes the FFmpeg build's licence when linked with it

allow.name: libav*
allow.why: FFmpeg libraries staged on macOS, same licence as ffmpeg

allow.name: libsw*
allow.why: FFmpeg libraries staged on macOS, same licence as ffmpeg

allow.name: libsndfile (inside the soundfile wheel)
allow.why: LGPL-2.1-or-later native library inside the soundfile wheel
